label: Читаемый
description: A 10-sentence card for читаемый, the present passive participle of читать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Читаемый comes from читать — the first-conjugation form читаем plus -ый. It agrees with masculine текст and means the text that is being read.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets читаемая agree with лекция. The -ем- suffix marks the first conjugation, and the word names the lecture being read aloud.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Читаемое carries the neuter ending -ое to match письмо. As a present passive participle it means the letter that is being read.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ые lets читаемые agree with газеты. The participle declines like an adjective and names the newspapers being read.

Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the inanimate masculine object журнал the participle keeps читаемый as the magazine we discuss. Читаемый журнал equals журнал, который читают — the one that people read.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Читаемой takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with книги, marking the widely read book as the source. Here читаемый verges on the adjective popular.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative noun шрифту pulls читаемому into the dative -ому ending. The word names the easily readable font that pleases the editor.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After восхищается the noun автором stands in the instrumental, and читаемым takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the widely read author.

missions.phrase: Мы спорим о редко читаемом романе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so романе and читаемом both take prepositional endings as the seldom-read novel we argue about.

Strategic focus: Plural nominative. Читаемые agrees with plural стихи through the ending -ые and means the verses being read aloud. The passive participle compresses стихи, которые читают into one word.
